entities.name: Andrés Soriano
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrés Roxas Soriano Sr. was a Spanish Filipino industrialist. Described by The New York Times in 1964 as "one of the most dominant business personalities in the western Pacific area," he was best known for expanding the original San Miguel Brewery evolving into San Miguel Corporation.
